svg.text: Cart and ordering are parallel behaviours in this dataset; forcing a linear cart funnel would misstate the conversion loss.

text.font-family: Barlow Condensed, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Segment conversion should therefore be analysed on order-user rate, not cart-stage drop-off alone.
